pattern_description: One device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) is transacting on cards of several unrelated customers within a month (27 other card(s)), a coordinated multi-victim scheme rather than a single stolen number. Found by traversing the graph from the flagged transaction to its device profile and back out to every card that used it.
